family.source: aravec/full_uni_cbow_300_twitter.mdl + ta-marbuta normalization + PCA-2D over the 44 referent vectors + unit norm
family.normalisation: NONE -- the stored vec2 are already unit-norm and inside [-1,1]
family.degeneracy_note: unit norm in 2D => PC1 = cos(phi) and PC2 = sin(phi) EXACTLY, so PC1 and PC2 are a deterministic reparameterisation of ONE number. A 2-feature register on this family adds FUNCTION-CLASS RICHNESS, not information (products of trig in cos phi and sin phi are not band-limited in phi -- Jacobi-Anger), which is why doc 52 SS2.2 found random labellings reaching 0.89-0.97 in the 2-feature space.

formalisation.why_stated: doc 50 SSC2/SSC3 under-specify the readout model; these are THIS FILE's choices, stated so the numbers are falsifiable rather than merely reproduced.
formalisation.orientation: relabelling outcome m -> m+1 (mod M) is a relabelling of the same M effects and flips parity for even M, so both orientations are legal and the winner is recorded
formalisation.simplex_vacuity_lemma: p_m = 1/M + eps (f_m - fbar) has sum 1 identically, is nonnegative for eps <= 1/(M max|f_m - fbar|), and preserves argmax. So the set of argmax patterns reachable from M NONNEG SUM-ONE elements of the span equals the set reachable from M ARBITRARY elements. The search is therefore unconstrained, and every witness is converted back to a legal probability configuration, emitted and numerically verified.
formalisation.part_A_span: p_m(theta) = <V_m, (1, cos theta, sin theta)>, V_m in R^3
formalisation.part_B_span: p_m(theta_a, theta_p) = <V_m, u_K(theta_a) (x) u_K(theta_p)>, V_m in R^{(2K+1)^2}. Each p_m is 3-term in EACH angle at K=1 -- the property exp67's smoke test asserts (doc 53 SS5 direction 1).

part_B_denominator.why_forced: doc 50 SSC3 does not state a denominator, but its own arithmetic does: 0.9105 = 173/190, 0.9000 = 171/190, 0.9688 = 155/160. 173, 171, 155 are ODD, and a pair-level count over casts is an integer out of |B||N| (95, 80) with no half-credit. Every one of SSC3's twelve M-ary cells is an integer over 2|B||N| and none is expressible over casts.
part_B_denominator.binary_column_is_different: doc 50 SSC3's binary column is doc 47 SS13's PAIR-LEVEL exact ceiling (both twins of a cast won together, antisymmetric form, denominator = casts). SSC3 therefore carries a pair-level column into a per-twin table -- doc 47 SS18.5's class exactly. The direction is safe (per-twin >= pair-level always), so SSC3's binary column is a CONSERVATIVE anchor, not a wrong one. This file reports both columns separately.

formalisation.nulls_not_computed: doc 47 SS16.1 binds CATEGORY-VS-NULL comparisons. No such comparison is made here -- every claim is within one category, across M, on one fixed inventory -- so size-matched nulls are not computed. Stated, not left to be noticed.

binary_anchor_selftest.rule: BLOCKING. The pair-level exact ceiling must reproduce doc 47 SS13's four published values before any M-ary number is written. Expected values are hand-typed above, capacity_check.ANCHORS style.

part_A_found_arcs.question: how many decision arcs can the hard argmax over M outcomes carve on the circle at K=1, under alternating grouping

columns.ds_bound_2M_minus_1: doc 50 SSC2's analytic column: order-2 Davenport-Schinzel envelope
columns.exact_maximum_2M_minus_2: NEW, proved here: DS gives <= 2M-2 index changes after cutting the circle at an interior point, and a closed curve forces an EVEN number of class changes, which removes the odd value 2M-1; the parallel- gradient construction attains 2M-2. So 2M-2 is a MAXIMUM, not a best-found -- this closes doc 50 SSC2's 'never the achievable maximum' caveat.

part_A_found_arcs.exact_counting: breakpoints are the closed-form roots of a + b cos t + c sin t = 0 for every pair; class is read at the midpoint of consecutive breakpoints. A grid can only MISS arcs, so the grid is used to drive the search and never to report a number.

monotonicity.how: STRUCTURAL. M=2 is seeded with the pair-level antisymmetric witness; each M is seeded with the best witness of the previous M plus DEAD outcomes (large negative constant component, which can never win an argmax). So pair-level <= M=2 <= M=4 <= M=8 <= M=12 holds by construction.
monotonicity.why_it_matters: doc 50 SSC3 carries an asterisk on uniformed / M=4 (0.8375 < its own binary 0.8750) and calls it optimiser failure. Nested seeding makes that failure mode unreachable.

supersedes_committed_per_twin_bounds.why_this_block_exists: the M=2 cell of Part B is the SAME optimisation problem as the committed per-twin general-C bound: argmax over two outcomes is sign(<C, phi>) with C = V_0 - V_1 unrestricted. So a better M=2 cell is a better value for a quantity two committed files already carry. doc 47 SS18.2: constructive bounds move with search effort and the stronger one supersedes -- but it must be SAID, not left to be found.
sources: capacity_check.py :: ANCHORS['exp68_FA_per_twin'] = 0.9250 (148/160), the nonoccupational FA per-twin anchor
supersedes_committed_per_twin_bounds.note_on_the_anchors: no committed selftest breaks. capacity_check's anchors pin what THAT budgeted search deterministically returns, and that is unchanged. What changes is the BOUND: the committed files now carry weaker lower bounds for the same quantity.
supersedes_committed_per_twin_bounds.note_on_the_families: instrument_sb_bounds verifies the raw-PCA angle IS the frozen angle (plane agreement ~2e-15), so the frozen2d FA and raw FA per-twin bounds are the same quantity and both are superseded together.

design_rule.statement: a category whose membership carves A arcs on the angle circle needs argmax over M >= A/2 + 1 outcomes before a per-referent arc classifier can express it at all, since the achievable maximum arc budget is EXACTLY 2M-2
design_rule.relation_to_doc50_S4: doc 50 SS4 states the K-side rule K >= ceil(arcs/2). This is its M-side twin, and the two levers are independent (doc 50 SSC6).
design_rule.caveat: arc budget is NECESSARY, not sufficient: the SB decision is joint in (agent, patient), and arc POSITIONS are further constrained by the span. Reaching the budget does not by itself deliver 1.0000, and the measured table is what decides.

scope: One inventory (24 frozen AraVec human nouns), one task family (SB), simulation, training-free. These are REPRESENTATIONAL bounds: they say what a readout CAN express, never what an optimiser will find. exp67 measured the second question and answered it NEGATIVELY for the circuit (arity_lifts FALSE) while the classical comparator on the identical features DID convert the budget (doc 53 SS7.1.3). Nothing here revisits that.
